newsitem.title: UK: Britain welcomes U.S. Senate chemical weapons ban.
newsitem.headline: Britain welcomes U.S. Senate chemical weapons ban.

text.p: Britain on Friday welcomed the U.S. Senate's ratification of an international treaty outlawing chemical weapons and urged Russia to follow suit.
The Senate vote was 74-26 -- seven more than the two-thirds majority needed for consenting to ratification of the chemical weapons convention, a step already taken by 74 countries.
"The U.K. has consistently urged the U.S. to ratify. We now hope that others will follow suit," a British Foreign Office spokesman said.
"We particularly urge Russia, as the other declared possessor of chemical weapons, to ratify at the earliest opportunity," he added.
The treaty, which comes into effect next Tuesday, aims to ban the production, stockpiling, transfer and use of chemical weapons worldwide.
